title: APPLICABILITY OF DENSITY REGULATIONS
previewText:
C1 C2 C3 C4 C5 C6

In the districts indicated, the maximum number of dwelling units on a zoning lot shall be as set forth in Section 23-50 (DENSITY REGULATIONS). The maximum residential floor area permitted for the zoning lot shall be determined in accordance with the provisions set forth in Section 35-30 (APPLICABILITY OF FLOOR AREA AND OPEN SPACE REGULATIONS).
